passwordReset.subject: Reset your password
passwordReset.preheader: Use this link to reset your password. The link expires in 1 hour.
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.body: You requested a password reset. Click the button below to choose a new password.
passwordReset.ignore: If you didn't request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email.

emailVerification.subject: Verify your email address
emailVerification.preheader: Confirm your email address to activate your account.
emailVerification.heading: Verify your email
emailVerification.body: Thanks for signing up! Please verify your email address.

accountLocked.subject: Your account has been locked
accountLocked.preheader: Your account has been temporarily locked due to multiple failed login attempts.
accountLocked.heading: Account locked
accountLocked.body: Your account has been temporarily locked after {{count}} failed login attempts. Please reset your password to unlock it.

emailChanged.subject: Your email address has been changed
emailChanged.preheader: Your account email address was recently changed.
emailChanged.heading: Email address changed
emailChanged.body: The email address on your account was changed to {{newEmail}}. If you did not make this change, contact support immediately.

accountDeletion.subject: Your account has been deleted
accountDeletion.preheader: Your Breeze account has been deleted.
accountDeletion.heading: Account deleted
accountDeletion.body: Your account has been permanently deleted. All of your data has been removed.

userInvite.subject: You've been invited to {{partnerName}}
userInvite.preheader: Accept your invitation to get started.
userInvite.heading: You're invited
userInvite.body: You've been invited to join {{partnerName}} on Breeze. Click below to accept.

invoice.subject: Invoice {{invoiceNumber}} from {{partnerName}}
invoice.heading: Invoice {{invoiceNumber}}
invoice.body: Please find your invoice attached. Click below to view or pay online.
invoice.pdfAttached: A PDF copy is attached to this email.

quote.subject: Quote {{quoteNumber}} from {{partnerName}}
quote.preheader: Your quote for {{total}} is ready for review.
quote.heading: Quote {{quoteNumber}}
quote.body: Please review your quote. Click below to view and accept.

mfaEnrollmentNotice.subject: Action required: set up two-factor authentication by {{deadline}}
mfaEnrollmentNotice.preheader: Your role requires two-factor authentication. Enrol by {{deadline}}.
mfaEnrollmentNotice.heading: Two-factor authentication required
mfaEnrollmentNotice.body: Hi {{name}}, your role requires two-factor authentication (2FA) on your Breeze account. Enrol by {{deadline}} — after that date you will be prompted to enrol before you can continue using Breeze.

mfaEnrollmentReminder.subject: 3 days left to set up two-factor authentication
mfaEnrollmentReminder.preheader: Your two-factor authentication enrolment window closes {{deadline}}.
mfaEnrollmentReminder.heading: Two-factor authentication enrolment closes soon
mfaEnrollmentReminder.body: Hi {{name}}, your role requires two-factor authentication (2FA) on your Breeze account, and your enrolment window closes {{deadline}}. Enrol now — after that date you will be prompted to enrol before you can continue using Breeze.
